<script>
  const fieldsToDisable = ["currency"];
  const fieldsToStack = [
    ["cost_to_pax", "currency"],
    ["total_cost_pax", "currency"],
  ];

  function getFormFieldContainerParent(fieldName) {
    const $formFieldContainerParent = $(`[name=${fieldName}]`)
      .closest(".form-field-container")
      .parent();
    return $formFieldContainerParent;
  }

  function insertFieldsInFlexContainer(fieldContainers) {
    const $flexDiv = $("<div>").addClass(
      "flex-row d-flex align-end v-col-md-12 v-col-12 inline-style-applied-flag"
    );
    $flexDiv.insertAfter(fieldContainers[0]);
    $flexDiv.append(fieldContainers);

    $flexDiv
      .children()
      .addClass("flex-shrink-1 mr-auto")
      .removeClass("v-col-md-12 v-col-12");
  }

  function stackFieldsSideBySide() {
    fieldsToStack.forEach((fieldsArray) => {
      const fieldParents = fieldsArray.map((name) =>
        getFormFieldContainerParent(name)
      );
      const allFound = fieldParents.every(($el) => $el && $el.length > 0);
      if (!allFound) return;
      const alreadyWrapped = fieldParents.some(
        ($el) => $el.closest(".inline-style-applied-flag").length > 0
      );
      if (alreadyWrapped) return;
      insertFieldsInFlexContainer(fieldParents);
    });
  }

  function disableFields() {
    fieldsToDisable.forEach((fieldName) => {
      $(`[name=${fieldName}]`).attr("disabled", true);
    });
  }

  let updateTimeout;
  whenEvent("render:finish", () => {
    clearTimeout(updateTimeout);
    updateTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      disableFields();
      stackFieldsSideBySide();
    }, 100);
  });
</script>
